result.description: Cloud observability and security platform: metrics, logs, traces, monitors, dashboards, incidents.
result.auth_detail: REST API: DD-API-KEY header plus DD-APPLICATION-KEY header for read/most endpoints. Personal/Service access tokens (bearer) and OAuth 2.0 are supported for the MCP server (per setup page summary, unverified verbatim). Per-site regional base URLs.
result.access_detail: Anyone can sign up for a Datadog org and create API/app keys. Full product is a time-limited trial, then paid; limited free tier exists. Not verified from fetched pages, so confidence is medium or low.
result.api_notes: Large public REST API (v1/v2) covering metrics, logs, monitors, dashboards, incidents, SLOs, synthetics, users, security and more. Official client libraries exist. Users must pick the correct regional site (US1, US3, US5, EU1, AP1, AP2, UK1).

evidence.quote: Authenticate to the API with an API key using the header `DD-API-KEY`.
For some endpoints, you also need an Application key, which uses the header `DD-APPLICATION-KEY`.
All requests to Datadog's API must be authenticated.
Requests that read data require full access and also require an `application key`.
The Datadog MCP Server acts as a bridge between your observability data in Datadog and any AI agents
The MCP Server has a fair-use burst limit of 50 tool calls per 10 seconds.
